name: usd-checkout
description: Price invoices in US dollars and get paid in HBAR. A Hardhat + Next.js template where a Pyth oracle price is load-bearing: the payer submits a fresh Pyth update with the payment, and the contract converts the dollar amount to HBAR on the spot.

envVars.description: Optional (packages/nextjs/.env.local). Pyth Hermes instance that serves signed price updates. Defaults to https://hermes.pyth.network.
Optional (packages/nextjs/.env.local). JSON-RPC endpoint for Hedera testnet. Defaults to https://testnet.hashio.io/api.
Optional (packages/hardhat/.env). Override the Pyth contract address used at deploy time. Defaults to the Hedera deployment 0xA2aa501b19aff244D90cc15a4Cf739D2725B5729.
Optional (packages/hardhat/.env). Override the Pyth HBAR/USD price feed id used at deploy time.

steps.label: Run the contract tests (no network needed)
Generate a deployer account (prints its address; the key is stored encrypted)
Fund that address with testnet HBAR
Start the app, open /checkout, create and pay an invoice

steps.text: The README walks through every step, including how to find the payment on HashScan.
